name: Hindering
overview: The Scriptures reveal that hindering others from coming to Christ or receiving His blessings is strongly condemned. Jesus rebuked His disciples when they tried to prevent children from approaching Him, emphasizing that the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these (Matthew 19:14; Mark 10:13). Similarly, Luke 11:52 warns against obstructing others from gaining knowledge of God, as the lawyers did by taking away the key of knowledge and hindering those seeking to enter. The gospel, exemplified in John 3:16, invites all to believe and receive eternal life, underscoring the importance of removing barriers to faith rather than erecting them.
